description: Price of a Robinhood stock token on Robinhood Chain, by symbol (e.g. AAPL) or token address: the Chainlink feed price per token (dividends and splits included through the multiplier), how fresh it is, the on-chain DEX price where a Uniswap pool exists, and which sessions it trades in. Equity feeds follow US market hours 24/5 and hold their last price when markets are closed.
